soundness_flags.label: def:model-class and ass:conditional-ddd-parallel-trends
soundness_flags.one_line: The model class is a class of observed-data laws P, but its causal assumptions take E_P of undeclared potential outcomes; introduce a full-data law/causal extension and define P as its observed-data marginal.

soundness_flags.label: lem:pairwise-identification
soundness_flags.one_line: The model never assumes consistency linking Y_it to the potential outcome indexed by the observed enabling date, so the observed score D cannot yet identify the potential-outcome ATT.

soundness_flags.label: ass:nuisance-estimability
soundness_flags.one_line: ChernozhukovEtAl2018 supports score-specific cross-fitting and product-rate conditions, not the bundled conditional-covariance operator-learning condition stated here; retag or cite a covariance-weighted EIF result and specify its score-specific rates.

soundness_flags.label: thm:crossfit-attainment
soundness_flags.one_line: The theorem claims uniformity over M_n, but ass:nuisance-estimability gives only pointwise little-o learner properties and no uniform rate constants, regularization rule, or uniform inverse-stability condition.

soundness_flags.label: thm:canonical-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: One comparison cohort and one post-baseline contrast do not by themselves reduce the declared T>=3 full panel and aggregate model to canonical two-period DDD; also require the two-period/two-cohort submodel and a singleton aggregate.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of Econometrics 219(1), 101-122, 2020; primary full text restricted
source_verification_receipts.locator: Publisher abstract and bibliographic record; source-verification route required for exact equation comparison
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article treats two-period DiD ATT estimation, including doubly robust estimation and semiparametric efficiency bounds for panel and repeated-cross-section settings.
The paper introduces stacked DDD, identifies a positive stack-weighted estimand, and frames the method as a transparency-oriented alternative to efficiency-focused approaches.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Define a full-data law P^F, state consistency and the observed-data marginal P explicitly, then restate causal assumptions under P^F and the identified functional under P.
Replace the canonical-reduction premise by an explicit two-period, two-cohort, singleton-aggregate submodel and verify equality with AkbariKiyavashGhassami2025 Theorem 5 equation (6).

Replace the generic nuisance assumption with uniform, score-derived rates for p, mu, conditional covariance estimation, regularized inversion, and all cross-group-event covariance blocks; cite the resulting covariance-learning theory rather than DML alone.
Add an explicit nondegenerate DGP with covariate-varying relative comparison precision that violates C_g,e and computes a positive fixed-GMM efficiency loss.

recommended_next_step: Revise the causal probability-space specification, uniform covariance-learning conditions, and canonical reduction; the corrected EIF-plus-attainment and fixed-GMM frontier remain a credible field-tier kernel.
